global_rules: Never append or invent a tracking identifier.
Keep ordinary tutor-owned Preply profile links non-affiliate unless a separately approved EkGuru relationship is configured.
Label every commercial link or clearly bounded group beside the link.
Recommend only an item or service directly relevant to the page and learner task.
Do not state a price, discount, rating, personal use or availability unless it is verified at publication time.
Do not place commercial links in tests, answer keys, forms, booking, payment, legal, contact, search, error, research or blocked pages.

programmes.name: Preply
programmes.allowed_future_context: A labelled alternative booking route on the matching tutor profile or a sourced tutor-marketplace comparison
owner_only_actions: Confirm programme approval and terms for India.
Provide the approved account-side tracking configuration without committing private credentials.
Confirm whether deep links to individual tutor profiles are permitted.

programmes.name: Amazon India Associates
programmes.allowed_future_context: A specifically reviewed Hindi book, keyboard or learning resource inside an editorial resource page; never a generic product wall
owner_only_actions: Obtain programme approval for the intended site and territory.
Provide the owner-approved public associate tag through deployment configuration.
Review current price/availability wording and required Amazon disclosures before each launch.

programmes.name: Impact
programmes.allowed_future_context: Only a selected language-learning brand that is approved in the owner account and directly relevant to the page
owner_only_actions: Select and obtain approval for a specific relevant advertiser.
Provide that programme's approved tracking configuration.
Confirm brand-specific creative, trademark and disclosure requirements.
